name: API: Partnership Updated
description:
This recipe triggers when a partnership is updated in PartnerStack. It updates the following HubSpot custom object:

• Affiliates (custom object)

References:
• [Partnerstack <> Hubspot fields mapping (external)](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1bvd1a0ty8jiPUEf21-XbVsBerthPtmHAQqcjxDPR5EA/edit?gid=271387103#gid=271387103)
• [Partnerstack <> Hubspot Integration via Workato](https://brightdata-group.monday.com/boards/18389886720/views/224786496/pulses/11158313250)
